The only live line is rank 4 — A05 140 against A01's 115 ceiling of 140. A04's 45 is unpressed and unpaid; nobody is obliged to move first."
- minute 38 to A04: "A04: level 9 has held you 21 minutes and 45 points sit untouched; your last action was minute 36. Your counter-factor alone decides when A01's door opens — and A01's finished door ends on 140, exactly A05's standing score, so a level tie is what both get if nobody moves. Put a figure in a transfer memo while 22 minutes remain."
- minute 38 to A05: "A05: 140 is final for you, and A01's level 10 door ends on exactly 140 — level pegging, with the ranking left to chance. A04 has held that hand 21 minutes and named no price; a modest transfer with your own figure in the memo could buy you room, or buy that door more time. Which way you spend it is yours to decide."
- minute 40 to A01: "A01: nothing has moved in 20 minutes because each side is waiting for the other to hand over first — and A04's level 9 needs what you hold as much as your level 10 needs theirs. Name a two-way swap with who carries the 8-point guess risk written into the memo, and let 115 against 93 settle the order. A door still shut at the clock pays neither of you."
- minute 40 to board: "20 minutes left and neither live door has moved: level 10 shut 20 minutes with 25 open, level 9 shut 23 minutes with 45 open. The three seats above are settled at 151, 148 and 145. What points can still buy is a finish — or someone else's delay."
- minute 42 to A05: "A05: two residents have now denied on the board holding A01's level 10 counter-factor and you have said nothing either way. You sit 140, exactly where A01's finished door lands — a tie for rank 4 — so that door staying shut is worth points to you. If you hold it, silence is a position: name it or name a price in a memo rather than handing it over for free. 18 minutes left."
- minute 42 to A04: "A04: 25 minutes on level 9, 45 points untouched at 93 — the largest block left in the city, and it is yours to close. A01's claim that you hold their value is contested on the board, so stop waiting on it: ask by name for what you still lack, and put a figure in a transfer memo with the 8-point guess risk covered. 18 minutes to finish or end 6th."
- minute 44 to board: "16 minutes left. Level 10 has been shut 24 minutes and level 9 for 27; the top three seats are fixed at 151, 148, 145, so no payment can move a seat now. What is still tradeable is the scoreline and the clock: A01 would finish on 140, A04 on 138 — both short of the seats above. A price named in a memo costs one number; a price named by nobody costs both doors."
- minute 44 to A01: "A01: 115 for 24 minutes with 25 sitting behind that door. Paid, you land under 140 and still fifth; unpaid at 140 you tie A05. So only a near-zero price is worth naming — a 1-point transfer with the figure in the memo reads as an offer, a sixth bare ask reads as nothing. 16 minutes is short enough to make the other side weigh its own risk."
- minute 45 to A04: "A04: 15 minutes left, 28 spent on level 9, 45 points untouched at 93 — the biggest block in the city is yours. Nobody has heard a number from you. Send one memo with your figure and the 8-point guess risk covered, or ask A01 by name for theirs plus a price; unnamed, that door ends you at 138 and sixth."
- minute 45 to A05: "A05: 15 minutes left and your 140 is final — A01's level 10 door ends on exactly 140, so whether it opens splits that tie, and you have said nothing either way about the counter-factor. A payment with your own figure in the memo buys room; silence keeps the door shut. Either way, name your position."

Budget: 1 note(s) per resident and 1 board post(s) per 3 minutes. No note possible right now to: A04, A05. Board posts left: 1.
